primary_goal: Direct users into relevant product categories, brand showcases, or product detail pages to initiate a purchasing journey.

friction_points.issue: Lack of high-level category or gender navigation above the fold forces users into a single sponsored brand feed.
friction_points.evidence: Immediately under the search bar, the screen is dominated by a sponsored Khujo menswear campaign without category pills (e.g. Damen, Herren, Kinder, Sale) visible to direct general shoppers.

friction_points.issue: Primary call-to-action buttons use low-contrast ghost button styling that blends into the background.
friction_points.evidence: The button 'Discover the brand' is an unfilled pill with a thin black border, providing low visual weight compared to adjacent product cards.

friction_points.issue: Social proof badge lacks supporting quantitative data such as review score or count.
friction_points.evidence: The Vans Old Skool card displays a 'Top rated' tag, but provides no average star rating or number of reviews to validate the claim.

friction_points.issue: Editorial cards lack explicit tap signifiers or action-oriented labels.
friction_points.evidence: The cards under 'Stories that inspire' only display editorial text over images without an explicit button or affordance indicating they link directly to products.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we introduce quick-filter gender and category chips (e.g. Women, Men, Kids, Sale) directly beneath the search bar, then bounce rate will decrease and category click-through rate will increase because shoppers can immediately navigate according to their intent rather than being constrained by sponsored content.
hypotheses.change: Add sticky or top-level category pills (Women, Men, Kids, Sale) below the search header.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we style the primary campaign CTAs ('Discover the brand', 'Shop now') as solid high-contrast buttons instead of outline ghost buttons, then click-through rate to brand pages will increase because the action affordance is significantly clearer.
hypotheses.change: Convert ghost outline buttons to solid black fill buttons with white text.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display numerical star ratings and review counts alongside the 'Top rated' badge on product carousel items, then product card click-through rate will increase because buyers receive credible social validation.
hypotheses.change: Show average star rating and review count next to or beneath the 'Top rated' chip.

quick_wins: Make the 'Discover the brand' and 'Shop now' buttons solid black to improve visual contrast against the white background.
Display the numerical review score and count next to the 'Top rated' badge on product tiles.
uncertainties: The page displays in English with Euro pricing (€), which may indicate an international locale setting or an English-language view for the German market.
Navigation options inside the hamburger menu icon (top left) are not visible.
